report.executive_summary: Autonomous threat hunt completed. Multiple ATT&CK techniques confirmed.

findings.title: Brute Force Attack on Administrator Account
findings.description: 15 failed logon attempts (Event ID 4625) targeting CORP\Administrator account over a 4-minute period (02:30:03 to 02:34:27). All attempts originated from IP 192.168.1.105 with LogonType 3 (Network logon), indicating a systematic credential attack. All failures show "Unknown user name or bad password" reason, consistent with password guessing attack.
evidence: Total 15 failed attempts against Administrator account from single source

findings.title: Lateral Movement via SMB to Remote Systems
findings.description: Network connections to remote systems on SMB port 445 using net.exe command. Attacker executed "net use \\192.168.1.110\C$ /user:Administrator Lab123!" attempting to mount remote administrative share. Additional connection to 192.168.1.115:445 detected. This indicates post-compromise lateral movement attempts.
evidence: Multiple SMB port 445 connections for lateral movement

findings.title: Extensive PowerShell Abuse for Command Execution
findings.description: Multiple PowerShell processes spawned by Administrator user executing suspicious commands including: Disabling Windows Defender real-time monitoring, loading Atomic Red Team framework, assembly loading for privilege escalation, process enumeration targeting LSASS. PowerShell execution bypass flag (-exec bypass) indicates attempt to bypass execution policies. This indicates post-compromise command execution and reconnaissance activity.

findings.title: System Discovery and Reconnaissance Commands
findings.description: Multiple system enumeration commands executed via PowerShell: systeminfo, hostname, whoami /all, ipconfig /all, and net user. Commands executed by CORP\Administrator through powershell.exe parent process. This reconnaissance activity is consistent with post-compromise information gathering before lateral movement.
evidence: All reconnaissance commands spawned from powershell.exe parent process

findings.title: Windows Defender Disabled via Defense Evasion
findings.description: Multiple attempts to disable Windows Defender protection mechanisms: (1) Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true executed at 02:44:54, (2) Set-MpPreference with both DisableRealtimeMonitoring and DisableBehaviorMonitoring at 02:55:58, and (3) Registry modification HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\DisableAntiSpyware at 02:56:28. These actions disable critical security monitoring, allowing malware execution without detection.
evidence: Multiple defense evasion attempts targeting Windows Defender

findings.title: Scheduled Task Created for Persistence
findings.description: Scheduled task created named "\\Microsoft\\Windows\\WindowsUpdate\\UpdateCheck" by Administrator at 2024-06-15T02:53:15. Task content shows PowerShell execution with -NoP (No Profile) and -W Hidden flags, with IEX (Invoke-Expression) indicating command injection/download execution. This is a common persistence technique using Windows Update task mimicry to hide malicious scheduled task.

findings.title: Registry Persistence via Run Key Modification
findings.description: Registry modification event at 2024-06-15T03:06:20 targeting HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\WindowsUpdate. A value named "WindowsUpdate" was set pointing to suspicious executable location "C:\Users\Administrator\App...". This is a classic persistence technique using the Windows Run registry key to achieve auto-start of malicious binary.
evidence: Value set to suspicious path: C:\Users\Administrator\App

findings.title: Audit Log Clearing to Hide Evidence
findings.description: Security audit log was cleared by Administrator at 2024-06-15T03:15:04 (Event ID 1102). This represents the final action to cover tracks after completing the attack chain, destroying forensic evidence of the brute force attempt, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and persistence activities. This is classic post-compromise log tampering.
evidence: Event 1102: Security audit log cleared at 2024-06-15T03:15:04
